text: Mobile app development is an exciting field today. When developers create apps, they must think about responsive design. This means the app should look and work well on different screen sizes, from small phones to large tablets. Another important choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one system, like Android or iOS, while cross-platform apps work on both. After building an app, developers publish it on app stores, such as Google Play or the App Store. Finally, performance matters a lot. A fast, smooth app keeps users happy, while a slow one is quickly deleted.
